Tournament Description

🏆 Life Time Winter Open @ Sugar Land 🦊
💪This is just what the doctor ordered!
Event Details:
The event will take place from Feb 6th-8th at Life Time Sugar Land.
Registration Information:
Registration Opens: Dec 9th, 2025 at 4:00 PM
Registration Closes: February 2nd, 2026 at 11:55 PM
Registration Cost:
Club Member: $35
Non-Member: $45
($15 Per added Event)
Teams must register and pay individually via pickleballbrackets.com with a credit/debit card.
Tournament Format:
Events: Men’s, Women’s, and Mixed Doubles.
Game Guarantees: All participants are guaranteed to play multiple games.
Divisions:
Saturday: Women's and Men's Doubles (2.5-3.0, 3.0-3.5, 3.5-4.0, & 4.0+)
Sunday: Mixed Doubles (2.4-3.0, 3.0-3.5, 3.5-4.0, & 4.0+)
Senior Age brackets available for registration: Age: 50+ (Under 3.5 & Above 3.5+)
Format:
Round-robin group stages with 3+ teams per group (minimum 2 games per group).
Medal rounds will be played in a seeded bracket, with medals awarded for 1st, 2nd, and 3rd.
ALL SCORES WILL BE electronically reported to DUPR. It is imperative that all players have a DUPR registered account AND that there DUPR account number be associated to their PickleballBrackets player profile under the “DUPR” sub-heading
We can't wait to see you on the courts! Get your partner and register today for a chance to win Medals & Joola IV Paddles 🏆
Delays:
If you're running late, please contact the Tournament Director for updated schedules. However, if you are more than 10 minutes late, your match may result in a forfeit.

Additional Information

Please contact us if you need help finding a partner.
If you have trouble registering or if your club member price is not correct, please email arose@lt.life
EXACT start times are TBD a week out from tournament start date. (Please check your email & website to stay up to date on start times)
Additional Info:
Refreshments & Atmosphere:
A variety of snacks and small bites will be available to tournament players to keep you energized.

Refund Policy

All refunds are subject to a $10 cancellation fee. No refunds for any reason after cancellation deadline of January 1st, 2026.
